verdict: Across the 2023-06 universe, gbm_all accuracy changes by -0.0406 per decade of events (HC1 se 0.0092, R^2 0.228, n 181) and the lift over majority -0.0265 (se 0.0094, R^2 0.083): busier contracts are less predictable, so activity is a confound that any group comparison has to hold fixed. In 2023-06, all ended contracts (45) have a median gbm_all accuracy of 0.6191 against 0.6123 for survivors (136): a raw median difference of +0.0068 [-0.0047, +0.0232], not distinguishable from zero. Controlling for activity (OLS on log10 events plus a group dummy, HC1), the group difference is +0.0061 [-0.0015, +0.0137], not distinguishable from zero; matched to the survivor contract with the nearest log events (with replacement), it is +0.0082 [+0.0010, +0.0171], distinguishable from zero (positive). Neither raw nor at equal activity is there a difference the data can distinguish; the controlled point estimate is above zero by 0.61 pp. In 2023-06, delisted contracts (33) have a median gbm_all accuracy of 0.6248 against 0.6123 for survivors (136): a raw median difference of +0.0125 [-0.0044, +0.0272], not distinguishable from zero. Controlling for activity (OLS on log10 events plus a group dummy, HC1), the group difference is +0.0084 [+0.0006, +0.0162], distinguishable from zero (positive); matched to the survivor contract with the nearest log events (with replacement), it is +0.0105 [+0.0021, +0.0214], distinguishable from zero (positive). At equal activity, delisted contracts were more predictable than survivors by this measure. In 2023-06, renamed or merged contracts (12) have a median gbm_all accuracy of 0.6151 against 0.6123 for survivors (136): a raw median difference of +0.0028 [-0.0309, +0.0228], not distinguishable from zero. Controlling for activity (OLS on log10 events plus a group dummy, HC1), the group difference is -0.0003 [-0.0154, +0.0147], not distinguishable from zero; matched to the survivor contract with the nearest log events (with replacement), it is +0.0019 [-0.0111, +0.0144], not distinguishable from zero. Neither raw nor at equal activity is there a difference the data can distinguish; the controlled point estimate is below zero by 0.03 pp. Within the 45 ended contracts with both fits, gbm_all accuracy in the last complete month minus 2023-06 has a median of +0.0058 [-0.0049, +0.0318], not distinguishable from zero (23 up, 22 down; median change in log10 events -0.03). At no change in activity (intercept of the change on the change in log10 events, HC1) it is +0.0073 [-0.0076, +0.0221], not distinguishable from zero, with a slope of -0.0333 per decade of events. 37 of the 288 screened 2026-07 contracts are flagged as stock, ETF or commodity perpetuals (identified by ticker name, or by a timing screen: median weekend day below 0.25 of the median weekday, or a median weekday share of at least 0.60 in the US cash session) and are kept out of the crypto comparison: EWZUSDT, COSTUSDT, UBERUSDT, SONYUSDT, IWMUSDT, URNMUSDT, VUSDT, CIENUSDT, BRKBUSDT, HPEUSDT, JPMUSDT, FLNCUSDT, ALABUSDT, ASMLUSDT, CRDOUSDT, SQQQUSDT, ASTSUSDT, XPTUSDT, CRWVUSDT, AVGOUSDT, AMATUSDT, QCOMUSDT, MVLLUSDT, GOOGLUSDT, PAXGUSDT, METAUSDT, QQQUSDT, BEUSDT, TSLAUSDT, CRCLUSDT, ARMUSDT, DRAMUSDT, AMDUSDT, EWYUSDT, XAUUSDT, SKHYNIXUSDT, SNDKUSDT. 27 of them were fitted. In 2026-07, new listings contracts (113) have a median gbm_all accuracy of 0.6309 against 0.6406 for 2023 survivors (138): a raw median difference of -0.0097 [-0.0201, +0.0045], not distinguishable from zero. Controlling for activity (OLS on log10 events plus a group dummy, HC1), the group difference is -0.0105 [-0.0230, +0.0020], not distinguishable from zero; matched to the survivor contract with the nearest log events (with replacement), it is +0.0005 [-0.0247, +0.0105], not distinguishable from zero. Neither raw nor at equal activity is there a difference the data can distinguish; the controlled point estimate is below zero by 1.05 pp. Q9's 10 symbols have a median gbm_all accuracy of 0.6001; the median over all 181 fitted 2023-06 coins is +0.6146 [+0.6096, +0.6214] (survivors only: 0.6123). The Q9 median sits at the 28th percentile of the full universe, and the Q9 symbols' activity at a median 95th percentile (median log10 events 6.81 against 6.12). Q9's 10-symbol headline understates the typical contract: it is -1.45 pp from the universe median, outside that median's interval. The activity slope alone predicts a gap of -2.81 pp for that difference in activity. None of this is a trading result: these are accuracies of next-sign calls on aggressor events, with no prices, costs or profit and loss.
